sources.title: LeBlanc Build Guide: [26.17][2941LP Challenger] Rank 1 LeBlanc's Gunblade 1v9 Build
LeBlanc Build Guide: [26.1] Shok's Rank 1 Challenger LeBlanc Guide

passive.name: Mirror Image
passive.text: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

spells.name: Sigil of Malice
spells.text: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

spells.name: Distortion
spells.text: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.

spells.name: Ethereal Chains
spells.text: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.

spells.name: Mimic
spells.text: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.

damage.value: LeBlanc deals magic burst damage rather than sustained damage.

archetype.value: LeBlanc is a mobile assassin who uses dashes, crowd control, and burst damage.

axis.value: LeBlanc punishes enemy cooldowns in lane with WEQ or QW rather than relying on a strong laning phase.

winCondition.value: LeBlanc wins by using her mobility and crowd-control setup to deliver burst damage.

spikes.at: After key enemy crowd control is spent
spikes.why: LeBlanc can dash in without waiting for that threat.

spikes.at: When LeBlanc's Mimic comes off cooldown
spikes.why: LeBlanc can cast a mimicked version of a basic spell.

mistakes.value: LeBlanc should not expect to deal sustained damage after using her combo.
LeBlanc can fall behind by farming a side lane when she needs to group for an objective.
LeBlanc misses the root if she does not keep a target shackled for 1.5 seconds.
